description: Find fonts used by live text and list artwork paint colors for prepress review. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.06 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. PDF up to 512 KB and 24 pages. PDF reports device colors; complex paints and raster palettes may be partial. Outlined text has no font metadata.

source.description: Literal SVG or base64 PDF bytes
